prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of this room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this room, the front view (the establishing view): the camera stands at the centre of the front wall, at eye level, facing the back wall, with a 35mm lens and natural textures. The room layout and furniture placement should exactly match Image 1. The place is completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette, mannequin or reflection of a person anywhere, including behind glass, through doorways and in the distance. Location: INT. SU YAQING'S DINING AREA. The elegant dining area of the same contemporary penthouse. A rectangular white marble dining table stands in the middle of the room, running from the left wall towards the right wall, with upholstered grey chairs around it. On the table are a glass vase of white daisies and a bottle of red wine. Left wall: a large window with sheer curtains, the main light source, casting daylight across the table from the left; one chair stands at the window end of the table. Back wall: a low walnut sideboard with decanters and a large framed print. Right wall: an open archway back to the living room, the way in. Front wall, behind the camera: a tall plant and a wine cabinet. A brass linear pendant lamp hangs over the table. Show only this place as described: the doors, windows and openings it names lead nowhere new, with no other exit, courtyard, corridor or outdoor view added. Light it with the sources the description names, from their direction, at a neutral daylight white balance so that whites are white; only lamps the description names may glow warm.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
